pages.text: Engines burn the fuels of your refinery and turn them into $(item)rotation$(). There are three small engines, all built the same way:

$(li)$(item)Regular Engine$(): the all-rounder. Its layout can be changed between five types (I, V, W, U and Boxer).$(li)$(item)Radial Engine$(): a fixed radial layout with eight cylinders and a built-in output.$(li)$(item)Turbine Engine$(): the fastest and strongest type, runs on turbine blades instead of cylinders.

Each one is a block you place, then $(item)right-click with parts$() until it is complete: first the components, then the cylinders. Blocks of the same kind placed in a row, facing the same way, join into one longer engine that gives more torque.

An engine never starts on fuel alone. It also needs a $(item)redstone signal$() (or an engine controller), an $(item)output shaft$(), and room in its exhaust tank. Wear Engineer's Goggles while you build: the engine always tells you what it is waiting for.
